title: Kanda 6: Hymns of Healing & Cosmic Harmony
summary: Sacred prayers of Shaunaka Shakha from Kanda 6.
ai_summary: Vedic hymns of health, protection, and universal peace from Kanda 6.

verses.original: सं गच्छध्वं सं वदध्वं सं वो मनांसि जानताम् । देवा भागं यथा पूर्वे संजानाना उपासते ॥
verses.transliteration: saṁ gacchadhvaṁ saṁ vadadhvaṁ saṁ vo manāṁsi jānatām | devā bhāgaṁ yathā pūrve saṁjānānā upāsate ||
verses.translation: Walk together, speak together, let your minds comprehend with one accord; even as the radiant divinities of old sat together in unanimous understanding!

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: The Sangathan hymn: collective unity of purpose, speech, and contemplation as the secret to invincible society.

layers.author: whitney
